relations.from: Two nets: the universe is estimated from the overlap of two enumerations made independently, so the members neither net caught are counted from how many the second net caught that the first had, as the marked fish recaptured, the census whose undercount is estimated from a second survey of the same blocks by a separate team, the two proofreaders whose shared and unshared catches give the number of misprints neither found, the two literature searches whose overlap says how much of the field either reached; the carrier is a second net that must be independent of the first, and the arithmetic that turns the overlap into a total; it makes countable the members nobody has seen, as a number with an interval, which no single enumeration can give, and it makes the first net's recall a measurable quantity rather than a feeling; it silently excludes whatever both nets miss for the same reason, since the arithmetic assumes that being caught by one net says nothing about being caught by the other, and where the nets are correlated, two counts made from the same records, two reviewers trained in the same school, two survey teams who both cannot enter the same buildings, the members missed by both are counted as nonexistent and the estimate is confident about exactly the people the census cannot find; the tell that the denominator was manufactured rather than found is that the estimated missing have no names, only a count, and a second tell is an overlap too high for the nets' reach, since two nets drawn from one source agree on the world as it looked from that source; observed, with the fish, the census's second survey, and the proofreaders as cases; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty the only mechanism on this map that measures the fraction held without a universe being given, at the price of an independence nobody can verify from inside either net; not Salted proof, where the second sample is planted by the enumerator and can only estimate members of the planted kind, since here the second net is another enumerator's and can catch strangers, and not Priced adversary, whose second net is bought and stops at a price.
relations.to: Muzzled net: a second enumerator is engaged whose remit forbids adding members, so its zero additions are read as the first enumerator's completeness and the universe is manufactured by a rule about what the second enumerator may say, as the repair pass of this atlas, whose brief says to apply every repair and cut the critic justified and to add no items of its own, and whose critic brief gives the fresh-context critic three decisions per item, keep, repair, or cut, and no decision that adds, so the only independent net the pipeline has is wired to return repairs and cuts and never a member, its one door to a new member, a verdict of return for another breath, hands the net back to the first enumerator, and the record it produces reads as reviewed and whole, the appellate court that may not take new evidence and so finds the record complete because the record is by rule all there is, the auditor who may test only the sample provided, the copy-editor whose remit is to strike and not to write, the second reader on a proof who is told to check the marks and not to read; the carrier is the second enumerator's remit, a rule that fixes what its catch can be; it makes countable the first list's errors of commission, since the muzzled net can still cut and repair, and it makes the first list look reviewed; it silently excludes every error of omission, which is the whole class a second net is engaged to find, and the exclusion is silent because a net that catches nothing and a net that may catch nothing report the same zero; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the second enumerator's output is entirely repairs and cuts across every list it reviewed, a distribution set by the remit rather than by the lists, and that no review in the record ever added a line, so an enumerator who wants to know whether a review was a net should look for one addition anywhere in its history; observed in this atlas's repair pass and in the appellate record, analytical in the general form; adds to witness-architectures' Trigger's blind spot, where the instrument is built not to see, the net built not to catch; not Two nets, whose second net is free and whose overlap is computed, since here the overlap is fixed at the whole first list by the remit and the arithmetic returns the first list as the universe.
relations.label: If the second net's remit forbids it to add members, then the overlap arithmetic degenerates, since everything the second net reports is already in the first list, and the estimated universe is exactly the first list, so the pipeline that meant to measure omission has by rule measured commission and reported the first enumerator's reach as the world's; where the second net may add even one member, the arithmetic recovers an estimate and the rule's zero becomes a net's zero.

relations.from: Own proposals: the universe is the enumerator's own output, so the fraction reported is what a judge kept over what the enumerator proposed, and the denominator was manufactured by the same hand whose work it measures, as this atlas's ledger, whose keep rate is items kept over candidates proposed, so it measures the gate's severity against the proposer's habits and says nothing about the subject's reach, and whose repair breath, forbidden to add items, reports a keep rate that can only fall by a cut and never rise by a find, so it read one on forty-one of forty-four repair breaths and fell below one only where the critic cut, and the rule that forbade adding reads back as a ceiling that looks like arrival, the journal's acceptance rate, whose denominator is the submissions and which therefore measures the submitters' expectations of the journal as much as the journal's standard, the search engine's precision without its recall, the hiring funnel's offer rate; the carrier is the proposer's own candidate list, taken as the population; it makes countable the judge's acceptance, which is a real quantity about the judge and the proposer together; it silently excludes everything not proposed, which is the whole of what a denominator was wanted for, and the exclusion is silent because a fraction looks like coverage, so a keep rate of one reads as a map that has arrived rather than as a proposer that has stopped and a judge that cut nothing; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the fraction rises when the proposer proposes less and touches one when it proposes nothing and the judge cuts nothing, since a found universe would make the fraction fall as the proposer went quiet, so any coverage figure that improves under silence has the proposer's output in its denominator; observed; adds to importance-detectors' Fudged figure the shape a coverage figure takes when its denominator is the reporter's own count; not Singletons' vote, which also uses only the enumerator's own output but reads the duplicates and estimates the unseen, since here the duplicates are dropped and nothing unseen is estimated.
relations.to: Open fence: the enumerator declares that there is no universe and refuses the denominator, so every omission is converted from an error into a non-event and the fraction held becomes an unaskable question, as the field guide to the common birds of a region, whose title excuses every rarity it lacks, the dictionary's preface that disclaims completeness, the survey report's out of scope, and the coverage line of this atlas, open with no claim of exhaustiveness, which forty-one of its forty-seven map records carry as the identical sentence; the carrier is a declared refusal, a fence with one side; it makes nothing countable, and that is its function, since it makes the list's omissions unfalsifiable and lets the list be judged on what it holds; it silently excludes the reader's ability to know when to stop searching, and it excludes the missing from being missed, so a member that was never found and a member that was found and cut look the same from outside the fence; the tell that the refusal was manufactured rather than judged is that it is the same sentence on every list regardless of the list, since a refusal that was a judgment about this universe would differ from list to list in what it refused, and a rule stamping the same words on forty-one records is a rule reading itself back as a finding about each; observed; adds to list-excellences' Negative space, which prizes the stated refusal as an act, the mechanism by which the act is counterfeited, and to Denominator honesty the case where honesty is declined identically everywhere; not Round wall, which gives a number with no members, since here there is neither number nor members, only a fence, and the two are the endpoints of this map's walk.
relations.label: If the proposer's output is the denominator and a rule stops the proposer from proposing, then the fraction can only fall by a cut and never rise by a find, so it reads one whenever the judge cuts nothing, and the only honest denominator left is a refusal, so the same pipeline stamps a ceiling of one on the ledger and no claim of exhaustiveness on the record and the two lines say the opposite thing about the same map; where the refusal is written per list rather than by rule, it can name what this list's own proposals could not reach, and the fraction can be dropped.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does an enumerator obtain a universe to count against when none was given, what does each carrier make countable and silently exclude, and what says the denominator was manufactured rather than found?
exploration.changed_question: Whose reach does the denominator measure, and who has to be unable to reach a member for it to be missing from the universe? Breath one took the universe to be the world's, obtained by a wall, a grammar, a product, a partition, a corpus, an overlap, a frequency table, a curve, or refused outright, and read each carrier's exclusion as a blind spot in an estimate of the world. Pressing on Singletons' vote and Flattening curve showed that every estimator built from the enumeration's own statistics bounds the process's reach and not the world, and pressing on Two nets showed that the estimate is only as good as the second net's freedom to catch a stranger. That turned the question from how big the universe is to whose net made it, and admitted denominators that are a remit (Muzzled net), a readership (Letters after printing), a planted sample (Salted proof), a day (Bar date), and the proposer's own output (Own proposals), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed the denominator was about the subject.
exploration.new_member: Muzzled net: a second enumerator is engaged whose remit forbids adding members, so its zero additions are read as the first enumerator's completeness and the universe is manufactured by a rule about what the second enumerator may say, as the repair pass of this atlas, whose brief says to apply every repair and cut the critic justified and to add no items of its own, and whose critic brief gives the fresh-context critic three decisions per item, keep, repair, or cut, and no decision that adds, so the only independent net the pipeline has is wired to return repairs and cuts and never a member, its one door to a new member, a verdict of return for another breath, hands the net back to the first enumerator, and the record it produces reads as reviewed and whole, the appellate court that may not take new evidence and so finds the record complete because the record is by rule all there is, the auditor who may test only the sample provided, the copy-editor whose remit is to strike and not to write, the second reader on a proof who is told to check the marks and not to read; the carrier is the second enumerator's remit, a rule that fixes what its catch can be; it makes countable the first list's errors of commission, since the muzzled net can still cut and repair, and it makes the first list look reviewed; it silently excludes every error of omission, which is the whole class a second net is engaged to find, and the exclusion is silent because a net that catches nothing and a net that may catch nothing report the same zero; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the second enumerator's output is entirely repairs and cuts across every list it reviewed, a distribution set by the remit rather than by the lists, and that no review in the record ever added a line, so an enumerator who wants to know whether a review was a net should look for one addition anywhere in its history; observed in this atlas's repair pass and in the appellate record, analytical in the general form; adds to witness-architectures' Trigger's blind spot, where the instrument is built not to see, the net built not to catch; not Two nets, whose second net is free and whose overlap is computed, since here the overlap is fixed at the whole first list by the remit and the arithmetic returns the first list as the universe.

priorities.item: Two nets: the universe is estimated from the overlap of two enumerations made independently, so the members neither net caught are counted from how many the second net caught that the first had, as the marked fish recaptured, the census whose undercount is estimated from a second survey of the same blocks by a separate team, the two proofreaders whose shared and unshared catches give the number of misprints neither found, the two literature searches whose overlap says how much of the field either reached; the carrier is a second net that must be independent of the first, and the arithmetic that turns the overlap into a total; it makes countable the members nobody has seen, as a number with an interval, which no single enumeration can give, and it makes the first net's recall a measurable quantity rather than a feeling; it silently excludes whatever both nets miss for the same reason, since the arithmetic assumes that being caught by one net says nothing about being caught by the other, and where the nets are correlated, two counts made from the same records, two reviewers trained in the same school, two survey teams who both cannot enter the same buildings, the members missed by both are counted as nonexistent and the estimate is confident about exactly the people the census cannot find; the tell that the denominator was manufactured rather than found is that the estimated missing have no names, only a count, and a second tell is an overlap too high for the nets' reach, since two nets drawn from one source agree on the world as it looked from that source; observed, with the fish, the census's second survey, and the proofreaders as cases; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty the only mechanism on this map that measures the fraction held without a universe being given, at the price of an independence nobody can verify from inside either net; not Salted proof, where the second sample is planted by the enumerator and can only estimate members of the planted kind, since here the second net is another enumerator's and can catch strangers, and not Priced adversary, whose second net is bought and stops at a price.
priorities.why: Its carriers are in this repo: the fleet briefs assign one author per territory, but the same territory brief can be handed to two authors who never see each other's record, and a blind judge can mark which mechanisms both found, which one found, and which neither; the overlap arithmetic then gives the first estimate any map in this atlas has had of how many mechanisms its territory holds that no author reached, and the correlation blind spot can be measured by comparing authors from one model family against authors from two.
priorities.next_question: For three territories, run two independent authors each, have a fresh judge align mechanisms across the pair, compute the Lincoln–Petersen total from the counts found by both, by one, and by the other; then repeat with the two authors drawn from different model families and see whether the estimated total rises, which would say the same-family pair missed the same members for the same reason.

priorities.item: Letters after printing: the universe is obtained by publishing the list and counting the corrections, so the omitted announce themselves and the readership becomes the denominator, as the dictionary whose readers write in with the word it lacks, the field guide's second edition made from the first edition's letters, the census campaign that asks whoever was not counted to say so, the bug tracker after release, the errata slip, the atlas that learns its holes from the person who looked for their county; the carrier is circulation, the readers who look for themselves in the list and find themselves absent, and a channel that brings the absence back; it makes countable the omissions that have an owner who reads, and it counts them at almost no cost to the enumerator, since the world does the second enumeration; it silently excludes the omissions with no constituency, the word of a language with no readers, the harm with no survivor, the species with no collector, the member whose interest is in staying uncounted, and the exclusion is silent because the correction channel reports only what someone wanted corrected, so a list read by nobody has no omissions and is complete; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the count of corrections tracks the circulation and the readers' register rather than the list's completeness, a widely read list of a small subject drawing more letters than a rarely read list of a large one, so an enumerator who reports few corrections has reported few readers; observed; adds to passages-between-levels' Scatter as reading the case where the scatter is the readership and what is read is the list's holes; not Parish register, whose corpus is kept by an institution's intake and grows by filing, since here the list's own publication is the intake and the members file themselves, and not Priced adversary, since the readers are unpaid and interested in being counted rather than in the list being wrong.
priorities.why: Low confidence that corrections track readership more than completeness, since a well-read list may also be a better one; high generative promise, because if it holds then a list's omission count is a circulation figure and no published enumeration can learn its own holes from a readership it does not have, so the atlas's silence about its gaps is a fact about its readers.
priorities.next_question: Take dictionaries, field guides, and open bug trackers with known circulation or download counts and known correction counts per edition or per release; regress corrections on circulation with the subject's size held by an outside estimate; if the circulation term carries the variance, then publish one map of this atlas to a readership that looks for itself in it and count the letters as the map's first real denominator.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing four items (Round wall's cases and tell, Own proposals' keep-rate claim against the ledgers, Singletons' vote's misread gate, Salted proof's modality) and the Own proposals → Open fence label; no item cut; the Induced cells fork renamed a join and the first adjacency named a passage in the seriation note and form inference; keep-rate wording in mode and boundary case matched to the ledgers.

neighbors.left: Singletons' vote: the universe is estimated from the enumeration's own rediscovery statistics, so the share of members seen exactly once estimates the mass still unseen, and the enumerator's own frequency table is the whole evidence, as the estimator worked out at Bletchley from how many things had been seen exactly once and published after the war, the ecologist's richness estimates built from singletons and doubletons, the estimate of the words a poet knew but never used from how many he used once, the search whose repeated hits on the same pages say the index is nearly exhausted; the carrier is the count of members seen once against the count of sightings, which any enumeration that records duplicates can produce; it makes countable the unseen as a share of the next sighting, so an enumerator can say how likely the next member is to be new without any universe being given; it silently excludes whatever the process never reaches at all, since a member with zero reach contributes nothing to the singletons and the estimator is a statement about the sampling process and not about the world, so a net that cannot reach the deep water estimates the lake as nearly counted; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the estimate moves when the same process is rerun and not when a different eye looks, and a second tell is an all-singleton list, every member seen once, which the estimator reads as an ocean unseen, so a generator that never repeats itself will always be told it has barely begun; observed; a case from this atlas: the climb drops an exact re-proposal of an existing member before the gate and leaves no record of it, and sends only the rephrasings to the gate, where they are refused as rephrasings and recorded as residue, so the rediscovery count this estimator would read is thrown away twice, once silently and once as failure, and the climb reads a keep rate instead, so the number that could have said how much of its own reach the list had covered never reaches the ledger; not Flattening curve, which needs the order in which members arrived and estimates a limit with an effort to reach it, since here one unordered bag with its duplicates counted is enough and no limit is named.
neighbors.right: Flattening curve: the universe is the asymptote of a curve of new members against effort, so the enumerator plots how many members each unit of effort yielded and reads the limit the curve is bending toward, as the collector's curve of species against samples, the rarefaction curve that lets two surveys of different effort be compared at the same effort, the reliability-growth curve of faults found against test hours from which a release is predicted, the trawl that stops when the last ten hauls brought nothing new; the carrier is the effort log, the order in which members appeared, and a curve fitted to it; it makes countable the total as a limit and the effort needed to reach a fraction of it, so an enumerator can be told that another hundred hours will yield three members, which is a stopping rule with a price on it; it silently excludes whatever the effort's reach never touches, since the curve flattens on the reachable and an asymptote is the reachable universe, so members behind a wall the method never crosses, the nocturnal species in a daytime survey, the fault in the path no test exercises, look like nonexistence; the tell that the denominator was manufactured is that the asymptote moves when the method changes and not only when the effort grows, a new trap or a night survey raising the limit itself rather than climbing the same curve faster, so a found universe would sit still under a change of method and a manufactured one jumps; observed; a case from this atlas: the climb flags a plateau when the keep rate falls below a fixed fraction, which is one point on this curve read without the curve, so the flag cannot say whether the limit was reached or the method's edge was; not Singletons' vote, which needs no order and names no limit, since here the order is the evidence and the limit is the output.
neighbors.separating_case: Two surveyors have counted the same marsh. One kept a bag of every bird seen with a tally mark per sighting and no dates; the other kept a diary of which bird was first seen on which day. The first can say what share of the next sighting will be a new species, from the share of species seen once, and cannot say how many species there are or how many more days it would take; the second can say the curve is bending toward some number and that ten more days will add two, and cannot say it from an unordered bag. Both are reading the same net, and neither can see the rail that only calls at night; the surveyor who confuses them asks the tally for a total it cannot give, or throws away the diary because the bag seemed enough, and the tell is whether the estimate has an effort on it.

checks.boundary_case: The tempting nonmember is the given universe, the class roster against which attendance is counted, the set handed to a checker, the population the question already named: found, not manufactured, and out by the declared type. The second tempting nonmember is the empty cell that yields a member, Mendeleev's gallium, which is form-yields' and is out because what it produces is a member and not a universe; Zwicky's box is in on that fence because the box's cell count is a denominator whether or not any cell yields. The third is the count bound, thirteen to eighteen, which fixes the unit and not the universe and is item-grains'. Own proposals sits on the fence with Singletons' vote, since both take the enumerator's own output as evidence, and is in because it estimates nothing unseen and reports a fraction that can only fall by a cut and never rise by a find, so it touches one when the proposer stops and the judge cuts nothing, which is a universe manufactured from the proposer's silence.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a join at Induced cells, two doors in and none out, Zwicky's box when the product's axes are read off the members instead of chosen first, and Filing classes when the partition's residual bin outgrows its classes, so an induced typology is where both a product and a partition end up when the world does not decompose along them, and it inherits the silence of whichever door it came through, a stranger with no cell or a misfit never filed. It shows a loop, Parish register → Letters after printing → Parish register, in which a published register gains a second intake from its readers and the next edition's silence is read as completeness when it is the readers' exhaustion, so a list read by nobody is complete. It shows a degenerate closure at Two nets → Muzzled net, where a second net forbidden to add returns the first list as the universe and the pipeline that meant to measure omission measures commission, which the walk conceals because the two sit side by side as second nets and differ only in a remit. It shows a passage at Singletons' vote → Flattening curve that adds an effort and a stopping price and no reach, so two estimators can agree on a universe that was the net's. And it shows a passage at Own proposals → Open fence, where a fraction manufactured from the proposer's own output and a refusal stamped by rule are the same pipeline's two lines about one map, saying the opposite thing.
checks.target_preserved: Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-13) judged the target preserved: each item names a distinct carrier, what it makes countable, what it silently excludes, and the tell of manufacture; the strange members (a universe with no members in it, a second net forbidden to catch, a readership as a denominator, a fraction that can only fall and touches one when the proposer stops, a fence stamped identically on forty-one records) survived the critic's collapse attempts (Round wall into Compiler's catalogue, Bar date into Parish register, the timebox as a boundary case) and were repaired as mechanisms with cases, not softened into advice about coverage; the critic's strongest objection, that Own proposals read the repair rule back as a keep rate of one when the ledgers show a ceiling of one, was applied to the item, its edge, and every line that repeated it.

coverage.universe: open; the fraction held is not claimed, and this map holds the mechanisms by which such a fraction is manufactured, so it declines to manufacture one for itself
